title: Genistein Ameliorates Rifampicin-Undermined Hepatic Cholesterol Efflux via the CH25H-LXRalpha-ABCA Pathway.
authors: Jiang, Wei; Zhang, Ding; Shen, Jinsheng; Hu, Xionghong; Jin, Xueli; Tan, Shelly; Zeng, Li; Wang, Hankun; Han, Shanshan; Chao, Jin; Peng, Qiuping; Liu, Zhaoyang; Xiao, Qing-Ao; Han, Lin; Huang, Yiling; Zhang, Xiaochen; Yu, Bo; Zhu, Yincheng; Liu, Wei; Huang, Xiaofei; Xia, Xuan; Wang, Decheng
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究染料木素缓解利福平肝损伤中的胆固醇外排通路，虽含分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白互作与代谢机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Rifampicin (RFP) is a well-known first-line antitubercular drug recommended by the World Health Organization. However, RFP-induced hepatotoxicity makes it impractical for use in long-term antitubercular therapy, and its mechanism is still incompletely understood. This study decrypts the mechanism of aberrant cholesterol metabolism in RFP-mediated liver injury and explores the protective effects of genistein (GEN), an isoflavone isolated from the dyer's broom plant (Genista tinctoria), when used in conjunction with RFP. RFP significantly promoted the formation of lipid droplets, increasing cholesterol deposition in liver by reducing cholesterol 25-hydroxylase (CH25H) and its downstream effector LXRalpha-ABCA to decrease cholesterol efflux. GEN upregulated CH25H and ultimately relieved RFP-induced liver injury; furthermore, replacing endogenous 25-hydroxycholesterol (25HC) both in vivo and in vitro accordingly rescued the hepatotoxicity induced by RFP. Finally, molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) showed that RFP could bind to CH25H and impair its stability, an interaction that could be reversed by GEN. Thus, RFP restrains cholesterol efflux by reducing the CH25H-LXRalpha-ABCA axis to trigger steatosis, while GEN restores this pathway by upregulating CH25H, facilitating cholesterol efflux and mitigating RFP-induced liver injury.
abstract_zh: 利福平（RFP）是世界卫生组织推荐的一线抗结核药物。然而，RFP引起的肝毒性使其在长期抗结核治疗中的应用受限，其机制尚未完全阐明。本研究揭示了RFP介导的肝损伤中异常胆固醇代谢的机制，并探讨了染料木素（GEN），一种从染料木植物（Genista tinctoria）中分离的异黄酮，在与RFP联合使用时的保护作用。RFP显著促进脂滴形成，通过降低胆固醇25-羟化酶（CH25H）及其下游效应因子LXRalpha-ABCA来减少胆固醇外流，从而增加肝脏中的胆固醇沉积。GEN上调CH25H，最终缓解了RFP诱导的肝损伤；此外，在体内和体外替换内源性25-羟基胆固醇（25HC）相应地挽救了RFP诱导的肝毒性。最后，分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）显示，RFP能与CH25H结合并损害其稳定性，而GEN可逆转这一相互作用。因此，RFP通过减少CH25H-LXRalpha-ABCA轴来抑制胆固醇外流，引发脂肪变性，而GEN通过上调CH25H恢复这一通路，促进胆固醇外流并减轻RFP诱导的肝损伤。
